calls.title: Growthbook | AirOps Proposal
calls.summary: The meeting focused on finalizing contract terms and pricing for a flexible annual agreement tailored to new market needs. The team confirmed the Pro plan pricing at $24,000/year with 75,000 tasks per month included, offering unlimited user seats. A discounted rate of $19,000/year was proposed to encourage trial adoption while reducing overage penalties. Integration with Webflow was discussed, emphasizing ease and cost-effectiveness, alongside ongoing improvements to resolve CMS-related issues. The team's approach aims to maximize client satisfaction and set realistic content generation expectations, with a trial focused on output quality rather than speed. Follow-up actions were outlined for feedback on pricing and content needs.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, pricing, trial evaluation, CMS integration, content tasks, discount proposal
